sections.from: Fuel stop near Royal Tunbridge Wells

sections.advice: Food stop near Chartham → High point in Silver End is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

Treat High point in Silver End → Scenic stretch near Stansted Mountfitchet as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

sections.to: Near Towcester, on the way back
sections.advice: Scenic stretch near Stansted Mountfitchet → Near Towcester, on the way back is the reward section in London motorcycle escapes. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.from: Near Towcester, on the way back

sections.advice: Photo stop near Blewbury → Near Woodford Green is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

glaubenberg-pilatus-backroads-and-susten.title: Glaubenberg · Pilatus Backroads + Susten · Grimsel · Furka Triple Crown
glaubenberg-pilatus-backroads-and-susten.slogan: Two days · overnight at Lucerne exit

waypoints.name: Lucerne exit gate
waypoints.advice: Lucerne exit is where the day begins. Next is Glaubenberg pass road, climbing 1107 m.

waypoints.name: Glaubenberg pass road
waypoints.advice: You top out at 1543 m here. The road climbs 1107 m on the way up to it, steadily. Nothing on this route is higher. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Sarnen food stop, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Sarnen food stop
waypoints.advice: A break here. You lose 1070 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Pilatus view road, climbing 527 m.

waypoints.name: Pilatus view road
waypoints.advice: Pilatus view road, early in the day at 1000 m. The road climbs 527 m on the way up to it, steadily. Next is back to Lucerne, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: back to Lucerne exit
waypoints.advice: Back at back to Lucerne. That is the ride. You lose 564 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Altdorf, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Altdorf fuel gate
waypoints.advice: Altdorf is the fuel stop for this leg. Next is Sustenpass west ramp.

waypoints.name: Sustenpass west ramp
waypoints.advice: You top out here; the road stops climbing. Next is Innertkirchen.

waypoints.name: Innertkirchen reset
waypoints.advice: Somewhere to get off the bike, 297 km in. Next is Grimselpass high point.

waypoints.name: Grimselpass high point
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section. Next is Furkapass glacier road.

waypoints.name: Furkapass glacier road
waypoints.advice: Furkapass glacier road tops the climb. Next is Realp fuel and descent check.

waypoints.name: Realp fuel and descent check
waypoints.advice: Fill up here — 42 km left and no pump marked after this. Next is Back to Altdorf.

waypoints.name: Back to Altdorf
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 467 km.

sections.advice: Lucerne exit gate → Glaubenberg pass road climbs about 1107 m in 28 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Glaubenberg pass road → Sarnen food stop drops about 1070 m over 12 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Sarnen food stop → Pilatus view road climbs about 527 m in 12 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Pilatus view road → back to Lucerne exit drops about 564 m over 11 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
back to Lucerne exit → Altdorf fuel gate drops about 436 m over 39 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Altdorf fuel gate → Sustenpass west ramp is 28 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Sustenpass west ramp → Innertkirchen reset is 21 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Innertkirchen reset → Grimselpass high point is 23 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Grimselpass high point → Furkapass glacier road is 8 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Furkapass glacier road → Realp fuel and descent check is 9 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Realp fuel and descent check → Back to Altdorf is 41 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Emmental Panorama Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1543 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 23 km. 527 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 564 m come off over 23 km at around 5.0%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.

scenicChapters.title: Klausen Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 56 km this is Klausen Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 16 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

glaubenberg-pilatus-backroads-and-susten.story: 426 km from Luzern to Altdorf, about 8 h 55 of riding. The stops in between: Sarnen, Pilatus view road and Lucerne exit. The climbs: Glaubenberg pass road, Sustenpass west, Grimselpass and Furkapass glacier road. It tops out at about 2,450 m. Susten Pass, Grimsel Pass and Furka Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.
